description: Attach a web address the person owns, such as www.example.com, to the project. Answers with the TXT record that proves ownership (challenge_name, challenge_token); list_domains also gives platform_name, the CNAME target that both proves ownership and sends visitors. The person adds the record where they bought the name; fline checks by itself for 48 hours, and check_domain checks now. Prefer a subdomain: most DNS providers allow no CNAME on a bare name. See the use_a_web_address prompt.
name: attach_domain
title: Attach a domain
